newsitem.title: FRANCE: New Valeo holder could up dividend - chman.
newsitem.headline: New Valeo holder could up dividend - chman.

text.p: A new shareholder replacing Cerus as the principal stakeholder in Valeo could increase dividend payments, Valeo chairman Noel Goutard said on Wednesday.
In a pre-recorded radio interview Goutard said the French holding CGIP's takeover of Cerus's 28 percent stake in Valeo was not a done deal.
"It is not a sure thing that CGIP will buy the stake," he said. "But be that as it may, our policy has been a regular increase in the dividend as we grow," Goutard said.

"If we have a shareholder who might replace Cerus as our principal shareholder, maybe that new shareholder would contribute with the other shareholders and the company's management to the intensification of this dividend policy which we always have in the back of our minds."
"We continually raise the dividend so we are not hostile to shareholders' expectations of an ever-higher dividend," Goutard said. "That is entirely in line with our strategy."
